TKK also announced the expiration and final results of the tender offer it conducted to purchase up to 25,000,000 of its ordinary shares, at the final price of approximately $10.31 per share, net to the seller in cash (the "Tender Offer"). The Tender Offer expired at 5:00 p.m., New York City time, on February 13, 2020. As of the expiration of the Tender Offer, a total of 24,986,159 ordinary shares have been validly tendered and not withdrawn.
